description_ru: Девушка помогает заблудившемуся туристу найти отель, и за обедом они становятся друзьями.
text:
Jun: Excuse me, miss. I am sorry to bother you. Can you help me, please?
Kim: Of course. What is the problem?
Jun: I am a tourist. I am from Korea. I look for the Park Hotel, but I cannot find it. My phone does not work here.
Kim: Oh, I know the Park Hotel. It is not near. It is on Green Street, on the other side of the river.
Jun: The other side? I am walking in the wrong direction for one hour!
Kim: Don't worry. I am going to the station, and it is on the way. Come with me.

Jun: Thank you very much. You are very kind. My name is Jun.
Kim: Nice to meet you, Jun. I am Kim. Is this your first time in the city?
Jun: Yes. I arrive this morning, and I am very tired. The plane is late, and my suitcase is heavy.
Kim: Let me help you with the suitcase. Look, the bridge is in front of us. We cross it now.
Jun: What a beautiful river! The water is so blue. And look at the old houses. They are yellow and pink.
Kim: Yes, many tourists take photos here. It is my favourite place in the city.

Jun: Are you hungry, Kim? I am hungry. I eat nothing since the plane.
Kim: Me too. There is a good little café after the bridge. They make the best soup in town. Do you want to go there first?
Jun: Yes, please. I want to pay for your lunch. It is my thank you.
Kim: That is very nice, but it is not necessary. Well, okay. Maybe just a coffee.
Jun: Deal. Look, there is the café. It has a green door and a small blue sign.
Kim: Yes, that is the one. Let's go inside. It is warm there.

Kim: Look, Jun, the old clock tower. It is more than three hundred years old.
Jun: Three hundred years? In Korea we have old towers too, but I never see one with a clock like this.
Kim: Every day at noon, the bells play a song. Listen, it starts now.
Jun: It is beautiful. I record it on my phone. My wife loves music like this.

Kim: Two soups and two coffees, please. The soup today is tomato, right?
Jun: Tomato soup is my favourite! At home, my mother makes it every Sunday. What do you do, Kim? Do you work or study?
Kim: I am a teacher. I teach music at a small school. And you?
Jun: I am an engineer. I build bridges, so I love this city. Tomorrow I have a meeting about a new bridge here.
Kim: That is wonderful! So you are a bridge builder, and I meet you on a bridge.
Jun: Yes! That is a funny story. I tell it to my wife tonight.

Jun: This soup is delicious. Thank you, Kim. Now I am a new man.
Kim: You are welcome. Look at the time, it is half past two. Your hotel is still far. We need to go now.
Jun: Yes. But first, I pay the bill. Please do not say no.
Kim: Okay, okay. Thank you for lunch, Jun. Now we turn left at the corner. Then we walk along Green Street for ten minutes.
Jun: Ten minutes is fine. I feel strong again after the soup.
Kim: Good. Look, you can see the hotel from here. The big white building with the flags.

Jun: At last! The Park Hotel! I cannot believe it. Kim, you are my angel today.
Kim: It is nothing. I am happy to help. Here is my phone number. If you need anything in the city, call me.
Jun: That is very generous. Maybe you can show me the best places. I stay here for one week.
Kim: I am free on Saturday. We can visit the old market and the big museum. Are you interested?
Jun: Very much! And the lunch is on me again.
Kim: We will see. Now go inside and rest. Good luck with your meeting tomorrow.

Jun: Hello, Kim? It is Jun. The meeting is a great success!
Kim: That is great news. Congratulations! How do you feel?
Jun: I feel happy and a little hungry. The people are very friendly, and they like my plan for the bridge.
Kim: So you are building a bridge in my city?
Jun: Yes. And I want to name it after the kind woman who helps a lost tourist.
Kim: Please don't do that. Everybody will laugh at me. Name it Friendship Bridge instead.
Jun: Friendship Bridge. I like it. See you on Saturday, my friend.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, воздух выдыхайте мягко; не заменяйте на «с» или «з».
Язык между зубами, голос включён; не заменяйте на «з» или «д».
Спинка языка касается мягкого нёба, звук идёт через нос; не добавляйте «г» в конце.
Выделяйте ударный слог длиннее и громче, остальные слоги произносите короче и слабее.

questions.question: What is Jun's job?
questions.answer: He is an engineer and builds bridges.

questions.question: What do Jun and Kim eat for lunch?
What name do they choose for the new bridge?
